While this mimics vintage film or poor lighting, in AI generation, this often serves as a mask for texture synthesis failures. The 'noise' looks somewhat uniform and plastered rather than optical sensor noise.

The extremities (hands/feet) lack clear definition and appear to melt slightly into the background or blur excessively beyond what motion blur would naturally produce. The fingers/toes are indistinct blobs.

The connection between the arm and torso is somewhat ambiguous due to the lighting and angle. The arm seems to emerge without a clear shoulder joint definition, appearing slightly fused with the back.
